findings.text: Forward iteration with slice deletion skips consecutive matches: when ExpectedCalls[i] is removed, the element at i+1 shifts to position i, but the loop increments i, skipping it. Input: three identical expected calls - only the first and third would be removed, leaving the second.

0.reason: The finding describes the exact same root cause: iterating forward over ExpectedCalls while removing elements with append(slice[:i], slice[i+1:]...) causes skipped elements and potential out-of-range panics.
